evidence.name: Screen field: How rounded the media is
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How rounded the media is" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How rounded the media is
sections.description: Rounds the corners of the media block; 0 is sharp and higher values (up to 50) make them softer. A small radius around 8 to 16 gives a modern, polished look; match it to the rounding on your buttons and cards so the whole screen feels consistent. Leave it at 0 for full-bleed media that touches the screen edges.
